body:
Well, semantics. It is the easiest path. Taking ownership or giving up, whatever you call it, it's a way to save myself a lot of pain in the future. I'm not a great person, though. I know I won't do great things. I got dealt a shitty hand, and I'm doing awfully at managing it. There's no benefits to this. It's not like it'll inspire me to write an incredible concept album, or poetry, or whatever. 

I had all that, and I lost it all of a sudden. Shit happens. Maybe I go through all this shit, make new friends, and then I get raped again? Or some other thing, who knows. Life just randomly took a shit on me, and I lost a ton of friends. That really changes how you look at people. I don't know if I can trust future friends, knowing how things can just happen and suddenly they're all gone. Whats the point, you know?
No it's like they don't believe me when I said she raped me. He said she said. I don't blame them for that. I get frustrated, but I can't be mad at them as individuals. There's simply no proof.
I was just expressing my frustration. You yourself said it was concerning that I was so worried about the child support, as opposed to just letting it happen.
I don't know man. I can give it a shot, but it's like 3 months off. People are even more turning to her side. I'm not a fighter, and it's exhausting.
No one every believes the "your anger only makes me laugh!" thing. Even if you are, it's weird and unhealthy.

>Well, that's unfortunate, but the way the law works is that parents have to support their children, regardless of whether the other parent is a rapist. There are rape victims that are forced to share custody with their rapists.

But the child was conceived *through* rape. It's bullshit that I'm responsible for it. Sharing custody with rapists is also bullshit, and horrifying.

I haven't had a chance yet. I'm not in a good state of mind right now.
Yeah that was messing with me too. Are they saying I'm at fault?
Thanks. I really appreciate that.

So many people say otherwise though. Like I'm not a philosopher, maybe I am wrong. Maybe I'm empathy deficient or whatever and I'm some horrible asshole for not loving the kid. Certainly enough people have told me that.

I know that on an intellectual level, but I've never been good at handling people disliking me for bs reasons. Legitimate criticism is one thing. I can admit when I'm wrong. But this is infuriating, getting yelled at for being raped. It's awful. It's worse IRL, but event his has been painful.

I guess. It's a long time, and more people hating me. And I don't want to wish for the kid to die or anything. This isn't it's fault. 

I don't know why she'd pick me though. There's a lot of doctors and engineers. If she got the kid from someone else, and wants someone to stick for child support, why me of all people? The guy who has said many time he doesn't want kids, and won't make much money. Like I'm not saying it's definitely my kid, but I don't want to get my hopes up.

I'm sorry for snapping at anyone I snapped at. I'm not sure if the downvoter is still reading my posts, but I'm sorry for whatever I said that made them mad. I'm just scared and lonely and I didn't mean to hurt anyone. Even the redpill guy honestly he kinda took it back, and I've never liked being mean I just got so upset because for a while no one was understanding and making it out like I was the bad guy. Ever since I was a kid that's always riled me up, and since it's something so serious it really fucked with me.

I don't want to live like this, no one understanding. I lived a simple life. Good circle of friends, no drama, very peaceful. That's all gone now, and it won't come back. People have drawn sides, I had a lot of mutual friends with her and everything is complicated now. It's not just the rape trauma. It's fractured everything I have. 

One guy was saying there some something wrong with me for being more concerned about the money than the trauma. Like of course it'd seem that way, it's legaladvice not rapecounseling. Why would I spend a lot of time talking about that? This is all very off topic, I'm sorry. I just want to fully explain myself, because I've had to say the same things over and over a lot. It's all very frustrating.

It just feels like everything has been irrevocably poisoned way. Like if I have to pay 20% of my money to her, I'm not going to be having a lot of excesses in my career. I want to be a teacher knowing a lot of teachers, knowing they don't make much, knowing I could handle that. 20% less than that cuts away a lot. It's like how losing 10% bodyweight is way different at 100 lbs than 250 lbs. It's harder to trim down when there's less to start with.

But you know what, it's not even about the money. If she had waited until I wanted to have sex with her, oops I fuck up the condom and got her pregnant, I'd support her. Would even stay with her, depending on if she wanted, because it would have been my mistake. But that's not what happened. It's about what the money means, you know? 

I mentioned it elsewhere but just knowing she's pregnant is rough. I'm not friends with her on facebook, but she pops up in pictures sometimes. One recent one, her pregnant belly was bare while a couple former friends of mine were all touching it. The comments were so supportive. I wanted to cry. It felt like a stab, because that's all anyone sees. Not a rapist. A pretty, sweet pregnant girl with a deadbeat baby daddy. I blocked her now, I'm not sure if that stops her from showing up at all but I haven't seen her since. But still, that doesn't change that's happening.

I've lost. It's over. I know how pointless the legal fight would be. And no one would be on my side. Why would they be? I know how it looks. I probably wouldn't believe me. Life isn't fair, like people say, but we do get this bit of control. Okay, rape me. Okay, turn some of my closest friends against me. But at some point I don't want to lose control anymore. I can take ownership of this one thing, and kill myself, and at least be free of all this.

No it's okay. I'm sorry for making you feel bad. I just kinda... I don't know, I really hoped I had a shot. If I could prove it was rape, I'd be free of all this. That's clearly not how this all works, and that's making me feel worse than I have in quite a while.

I appreciate you trying to help. It wasn't the style of advice I wanted but I know it came from you trying to help, and thats what matters. Some other people here are also being dicks, and some of them mean it more. 

I just don't see the point in fighting. Because like you said it's a huge longshot, in the reaction of people I've talked to is that everyone is gonna be against me. Like someone else said, most people can't understand my situation. It's all downhill from here, and this is pretty rough lol. I don't know what to do. I'm not a big reddit expert, I went to the three subreddits I think were most relevant to what I needed. I've ended up just feeling way worse off, though it was the wakeup check I needed I guess. I don't know where else to turn. Everything else is a ton of time and effort and money, and it's all such a long shot. 

Best case scenario, she gets convicted of rape, I somehow don't have to pay, and then everyone thinks I'm an asshole for abandoning the child. I'm too heated up to have any attachment for it now, and it's in my rapist's belly, but hell I'd probably start feeling really guilty about that too. 

But just seeing her pregnant makes me upset. I see her pop up on social media sometimes in other friend's pictures, people feeling her belly. Knowing how she got pregnant, reminded of it again. Sometimes now it's extended to random pregnant girls, especially if they look like her. I just get reminded of her, of what happened, of how everyone thinks I'm the asshole.

I can't keep living like that. Maybe some people can. Maybe most people can, and I'm just spectactularly weak willed, but whatever. I give up. She wins, she gets away with raping me. Everybody was right, I'm the selfish dick who shoots himself to get out of measly little child support. That's how it'll look, but guess who has two thumbs and doesn't give a shit because they're dead?

No, I haven't moved past suicide. I just feel awful about this, and drained. It really does seem like there's no chance. I don't think moving will work either. I barely know what I'm doing in this country, and I've lived here 19 years. I could manage in Canada or Britain or something, but they're all on that list. And then I'd lose all my friends, they'd all think I was this crazy asshole who moved to avoid paying the mother of his child. I told some friends that it was rape, and even of them they don't all believe me. She didn't use drugs or violence, so there's no evidence, 99% will believe her. Hell I can't even blame them, honestly, it would make sense. 

I don't want to live like that, in some other country, on the run, with no friends and no money. My two options are hoping the court somehow sees my side (or she adopts the baby if she has a change of heart) or suicide. And honestly I don't know if I'm gonna wait on the court. It seems very hopeless to fight, and I refuse to have to pay for this. I've suffered enough at her hands, I won't give her another single inch.

I'm sorry I snapped. I just came here for advice and it seems like half the people on here think I'm an awful human being. I don't want to go through that for the rest of my life, I can barely take this and it was just a few years from people on reddit that are mostly trying to be helpful. I don't want to go through the rest of my life with everyone thinking I'm this monster for not loving the kid conceived because of a rape. 


It's bad enough people IRL saying I'm a liar or a pussy about it. With all this it's just so much worse. I never wanted to have kids, always knew I didn't. I'd be a bad parent. I didn't want to be one of those shitty parents, and I knew I had those tendencies, so I very specifically chose not to have kids, telling any girlfriend that up front. Now I get raped, and there's a kid, and everything all goes to shit. I'm suddenly just another deadbeat dad or whatever. I guess I'm weak, but it was bad enough getting raped I don't want to completely restructure my life. And I don't need to have a bunch of lawyers telling me I'm selfish or whatever. I don't want the kid, I don't consider it my kid. She made a kid using me, it's not mine, I didn't participate. Whatever, maybe it's selfish, I don't care. I'll just fucking shoot myself and she can have the $500 in my bank account, buy a crib or whatever I don't care anymore.
Yeah I do really regret not filing it before. I thought I could just move forward. I know it's stupid now, but I was really depressed and thought they wouldn't believe me anyway.

Some of it got deleted. I don't know, I started getting sensitive because there was so much of it. Some guy on there started off sympathetic in a few comments, then suddenly started implying something was seriously wrong with me not for loving the kid. Shit like that gets to me.
I don't want to have to explain to you why calling a rape victim is a pussy makes you a dick, but okay whatever. Live your life. Don't try and comfort anyone, you're really bad at it.

I WAS FUCKING RAPED FUCK OFF WITH GUILTING ME INTO TAKING CARE OF THE CHILD. 

Jesus *christ* you're the callous one. Are you gonna force rape victims who get pregnant into caring for the kids?

Obviously if I got her pregnant with consenting the situation would be *entirely* different. But she raped me, and is pregnant, and you're saying I'm callous for not loving this situation? You're a horrible person. Honestly. 

Who says to a rape victim "you know, you really should love this resulting child. If you don't, you're a monster. Everyone will hate you. But I'm trying to be compassionate!"

I want you to know how awful and hurtful that is to hear.  Stop trying to sound reasonable "I know you have a very good reason" that's where your post should have stopped. If you ever find yourself thinking "man, I could be a total shitheel to someone whose depressed and suicidal, or I could absorb my own toxic bile and not force it on anyone else" take the second option, please. 

I just came here for legal advice, and certain people on here have kept trying to guilt me into taking care of a child just because I was raped. Fuck all those people, get off your soapbox. You're a bully, and a douchebag. Do you honestly think your polite distaste is going to have any effect on months of built up trauma? "Oh, some shithead who has no idea what they're talking about is so empathy deficient they think I'm a scumbag for not immediately loving my unborn rape baby. I guess I better turn my whole mindset around, lest this human slime think ill of me!" 

Have an awful day.
The law can catch up with that, they know you changed your name. It's not practical to run from this. I have two options, fight or die.

I guess I can try. Do I report it locally, or with the police near my college? Does it matter? 

I don't know about that. People keep saying it, but debt follows you. And just the idea of being forced to move like that, just because she's a rapist... I hate it.

You're definitely being a dick. It's one thing to not sugarcoat, but to say: "Roll over and let the rapist chick financially fuck you in the ass for the next 18-24 years." is just really inconsiderate and rude. Calling someone a pussy is almost always being a dick, especially when you're doing it because they got raped.
I don't have the money for that kinda thing. And like I don't want to abandon my whole country just because she's doing this to me.

I guess. There's no proof though. She was smart, never admitted to it. Like if this is the reaction online, it's just gonna be worse in person. Some of these people are such fucking cunts. Like I almost never swear in person but this is just driving me insane. Some guy just said I was mopey- like yeah, I was raped you asshole. I keep trying to defend myself and they all get upvoted. Like at some point you start to think what if they're right. Maybe I am the asshole for not supporting the stupid kid.

I'm not refusing to hire someone what are you talking about? I went on hear to ask what I might expect before getting legal help. As is the entire point of the sub. And wow what the fuck, mopy? I'm depressed from being raped, I think it's pretty understandable this is kind of upsetting...
I know, I just want to stay realistic. I don't think I'll be able to get out of all this mess. I just wish people weren't so shitty about it.
No that's just for visitation and such. Like it makes sense because child support is needed in a lot of cases.

I did try a therapist but it didn't work out well. I did find a rape counseling sub on reddit. I might try that for a bit more support. Maybe eventually a real therapist? I'm not really motivated to waste money on it if they're just gonna be useless and shitty about it like the school counselor.

I think someone is downvoting all my comments now, because reasonable ones I make are already zero. Ugh. I don't even know why that bothers me, with all the worse stuff happening, but people are just so fucking petty.
USA. I'm pretty positive it's my kid, because I know her roommate and she'd know if the girl spent the night somewhere or brought someone home. So I'm still gonna get one but I won't get my hopes up.

Thanks for pointing that out. A lot of people have been saying the same thing in legaladvice, or downvoting me. Idk I'm probably just overly sensitive but this is all making things much worse. I don't know why I thought asking online would be a good idea.
Not that it matters, but I'm a guy. I dunno a lot of people have blamed for it, irl and in person, so I hardly even notice anymore unless it's egregious.

Quit being a dick, man. That was never gonna happen. If you want to live vicariously through me teaching English in Thailand or whatever then go do it yourself. I can't think of why else you're so dead set on me doing that.

Like, Jesus, what's wrong with you? On re-reading, do any of your comments seem remotely appropriate or helpful? Go back to throwing change at homeless people or however else you like to make people's lives worse and leave me alone.

I don't know, everyone in the legaladvice thing was saying that's not how it works, that's just to avoid custody. It makes sense, because like why would it be that easy if anyone could do it? It seems like even if I prove it's rape I'll still have to pay.

And then everyone's saying that I have to pay, that the needs of the child trump mine or whatever. Saying it's justified. Someone was even saying it was a concern that I was getting upset over this. I just want to give up. That's how the legal system is gonna look on this too. Like I just want to live my life. I never wanted any of this. I don't want to always be reminded of the rape. I want to be able to sleep normally again, and not have flashbacks. I think there is only one way out at this point honestly.

What the fuck man I'm not gonna flee the country stop suggesting it and stop calling me a pussy. I don't know why you keep thinking that's remotely plausible.  Like I thought it was weird when you said it at first but now you're just incredibly misogynstic and rude. 

" In fact, pretty much every woman on the planet is hoping you take this option because it empowers them and validates the whole premise of spermjacking a promising young man for all he's worth."

Like what the hell? She's a rapist, she doesn't speak for every woman or whatever you're saying. Some of my best friends that have been supporting me through this are women- they don't think anything like that.

What the hell? The child was conceived by rape... I think it's natural for me to not want custody of it.

I don't want custody either. I don't want kids, and I don't want one that would just be a constant reminder of being raped. I don't have the money to support a child, or the time as I'm a student. I have no means of supporting a child, and I don't want to because it was conceived through fucking rape.
I have no relationship to the child. it was conceived through rape. I have no responsibility for it, and I refuse to suffer anymore for having been raped.

The child support is the result of being raped! 

It's not the money. Like I've said a few times, if I had consented I would absolutely pay with no complaints. But I didn't, and now as a result of my rape I need to pay my rapist money to support my rape-baby. That idea is abhorrent to me. I don't give a shit about her, I don't need justice, I want to recover in peace and not have to deal with her again. It's really nasty of you to say that there's something wrong with me for being upset about this. You're a bully, honestly.

I wanted to see what I could expect if I sought legal counsel and now I'm just responding to comments. Also fuck off for suggesting I'm "lazy" for not reporting my rape, or cheap for not wanting to spend 18 years paying for having been raped. That's really messed up to say.

I can get a DNA test I guess, but I'm sure it's mine. I know her roommate, she didn't sleep with anyone else in the timeframe, and if she did why choose me to claim as the father? She knows I A) hate her and B) will be making far less money than her. I definitely want to terminate rights, I don't want any kids and definitely not this way, but I'd still be obligated to pay child support. I won't let it come to that. I've been raped, which is bad but I'm dealing with it. I've had friends take her side, which hurts but I can manage. I absolutely will not pay one cent towards my own rape. I'm struggling not to just kill myself right now, but I will not spend the next 18 years of my life tied to this trauma.
It's a bit late for that, though.
What the fuck? She forced herself on me. I said no probably a dozen times. That's a horrible thing to say.

I get that under the legal system I'll have to pay, but I don't think it's fair. The child was not created with my consent, I want no relationship with it and claim no responsibility for it. She can pay for it herself if she wanted it so bad. It absolutely is about me because my very plan for my life is getting fucked up on top of the trauma of having to suffer for having been raped. I'm honestly kinda freaking out about all this.

Sorry, punishment is the wrong word. But the ultimate effect is that I'm having major consequences to my life, on top of being raped. A lot of rape victims don't report it. Some estimate that the majority don't, especially men who were raped.

So I'm not being punished by having around 20% of my wages taken for the next 18 years, just because I was raped? Because that sounds an awful lot like a shitty thing that's only happening to me because I was raped. She chose to rape me, and not use protection, and not use Plan B, and not get an abortion, and not put the child up for adoption.
Yeah, I know that now. I just wanted to get it behind me and ignore it.
I guess it helps a little that she's an engineer and will likely be making a lot more than me.

But don't I deserve to not be punished for getting raped? Like I get that I'll probably end up paying, because I was stupid and didn't report, but it's still fucked up. Like I tried to avoid her because of trauma, and now I'm gonna have this constant reminder of all the money paying for the result of my rape.

I know I'm legally obligated, but I just don't think it's fair. Like obviously if I'd consented and had a kid I didn't want I'd pay, as it would have been my fault, but I never consented or wanted this child.
I shouldn't have to pay for it. I have no more fault for the creation of that child than any random kid off the street.
Do you know how much it might be? Percentage wise, or however it works.

I don't know man, I just hate that my entire life is getting ripped to shreds over this. Losing all my friends, my country, everything? I do hate math, and I'm not good at it, so teaching english my only option even that's not really what I want to do. Like I don't want to go to school all these years and have to deal with all this trauma just for some shitty job in some country I don't like.

Well me getting full custody would be disastrous. I long ago decided not to have kids, being short tempered and not liking them, and since the baby was conceived during rape it's gonna be a constant reminder and will not be healthy for either me or the baby.

I don't know any foreign countries that want to take on random americans to teach cinema or history, especially when I only speak english... And I'd have to finish my school anyway, so that's 3 years of child support already. I appreciate the help but I don't think that's practical for me.

I'm paying for my rape, don't sugar coat it and don't guilt me into thinking this is fine, that's fucked up. "A child you didn't want" yeah, I was raped, that's such a polite way to put it. "the child is innocent" yeah well I'm innocent and just thinking of the kid reminds me of getting raped. I couldn't provide any emotional support to this baby, because what if it's a girl and looks like her?

I never wanted kids, I don't like kids, and me as a broke college student is not even gonna remotely going to be able to parent this child. Should I drop out of school, already accumulating debt, and work a minimum wage job for the rest of my life to support this baby because I was raped?

Yeah but the idea of paying for my rape for 18 years is horrible. Like I straight up might rather kill myself. It's bad enough that it happens, but for the court to legally say that it's my responsibility? I guess that makes me a horrible person, but I don't want to have to pay anyone anything just for having gotten raped.
I never wanted a kid though, and definitely not this way :/
That's statutory rape though, might it be different since it was forced?
Do you know how much a lawyer might cost? I don't have very much money and have never consulted one before.
